entries.name: Haida Gwaii daily quotas
entries.scope_note: Re-filed from z6:hg_* — the 2025-2027 synopsis administers Haida Gwaii from Region 1.
entries.regs_verbatim: Haida Gwaii Daily Quotas (See tables for exceptions): Trout/char: 5, but not more than 1 over 50 cm, 3 Dolly Varden, 2 from streams. And you must release: Trout/char under 30 cm from streams, All wild steelhead. Kokanee: 10 (none from streams).

rules.review_reason: The book prints '3 Dolly Varden' and names no bull trout. Across the corpus every other rule curated as DV+BT says 'bull trout' in its own verbatim (13 of 13); this was the only exception. The synopsis names the species actually present — z7b:bull_trout_dolly_varden.r1 says so outright: 'Since only bull trout are found in the Peace Region, we have removed references to Dolly Varden here.' Haida Gwaii is the mirror case.

entries.name: Mercury advisory
entries.display_name: Lakes of Vancouver Island and the Gulf Islands
entries.regs_verbatim: MERCURY ADVISORY Mercury levels in larger Smallmouth Bass in lakes on Vancouver Island and the Gulf Islands may be above national guidelines. The general public, especially children and women of child bearing age, including pregnant and breastfeeding women, are recommended to limit their consumption of Smallmouth Bass.

rules.verbatim: The general public, especially children and women of child bearing age, including pregnant and breastfeeding women, are recommended to limit their consumption of Smallmouth Bass.

entries.name: Trout daily quota
entries.scope_note: The chapter header reads '(excluding Haida Gwaii)', and Haida Gwaii's own quota table is printed beside it. Recorded as `outside_area` on every extent: it is what the book prints, not a precedence rule inferred from it.
entries.regs_verbatim: Region 1 Daily Quotas (excluding Haida Gwaii). Trout: 4, but not more than 1 over 50 cm (2 hatchery steelhead over 50 cm allowed, see table for exceptions), 2 from streams (must be hatchery). And you must release: All wild steelhead, All wild trout from streams, All char (includes Dolly Varden). NOTE: There is no general minimum size limit for trout in lakes or hatchery origin trout in streams.

rules.verbatim: 2 hatchery steelhead over 50 cm allowed, see table for exceptions
NOTE: There is no general minimum size limit for trout in lakes or hatchery origin trout in streams.
